mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_evaluation WHERE interview_id = #{interviewId} ORDER BY question_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_evaluation SET hr_score = #{hrScore}, hr_level = #{hrLevel}, hr_remark = #{hrRemark}, hr_edited_by = #{hrEditedBy}, hr_edited_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_questions, AVG(COALESCE(hr_score, ai_score)) as avg_score, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(hr_level, ai_level) = '优秀' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as proficient_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(hr_level, ai_level) IN ('一般', '较差') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as weak_count FROM t_evaluation WHERE interview_id = #{interviewId}
